About Your Coach

From Systems to Souls

The story behind Manovana, and the woman guiding your journey inward.

An IT professional for over 30 years, Malavika Hegde made a transformative shift into mind coaching — aligning with her true life purpose.

“Moving from Systems to Souls… Logic to Light… Tuning into my soul-driven purpose… I became a Mind Coach and Counsellor.”

As a dedicated Mind Coach, she has helped over 18,000+ individuals discover inner peace, break free from limiting thought and emotional patterns, and embrace a life of clarity and fulfilment.

“I understand the silent struggles of people who display happiness and success on the outside while carrying loads of pain from the inside.”

That understanding is the heart of Manovana — a Sanskrit-rooted name meaning a garden of the mind. Her work helps minds heal, grow and bloom the flower of happiness, love and peace, using a holistic blend of proven healing techniques.
